decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting requires military/marine certifications and knowledge far from the firm's building and industrial lighting base, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's office and interior lighting capabilities and customer base, allowing it to learn from early results and refine the product.
General interior lighting luminaires are core to the firm's existing lighting and controls knowledge, enabling strong assimilation and improvement.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics aligns closely with the firm's R&D, optical expertise, and strategic focus on human-centric and intelligent lighting, so it is likely retained.
Marine HMI searchlights lie far from the firm's core applications and demand marine-specific knowledge, making early results hard to interpret and improvements difficult.
Marine searchlights are similarly distant from the firm's existing knowledge and customer applications, reducing its ability to absorb and improve them.
